english.title: Direct a terrorist organisation - terrorism
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) directed the activities of an organisation which was concerned in the commission of acts of terrorism
english.legislation: Contrary to section 56(1) and (2) of the Terrorism Act 2000.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required.
(ii) See Section 1 for an interpretation of "terrorism".
(iii) See Schedule 2 for a list of proscribed organisations, although organisations which may be concerned in terrorism and are not necessarily restricted to those contained in this list.

other.penalty:
Life imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None This offence is also specified as a serious terrorism offence (Part 1 of Schedule 17A to the Sentencing Act 2020) and subject to serious terrorism sentences of imprisonment or extended sentences; see note (v) in section 306 for details.
